# freshdesk_ticket_forms (Data Source)

Every ticket form on the helpdesk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_ticket_forms" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `ticket_forms`.
- `ticket_forms` (Attributes List) Every ticket form the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ticket_forms))

<a id="nestedatt--ticket_forms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ticket_forms`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the form was created (RFC 3339).
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the fallback form.
- `description` (String) Text shown beneath the title.
- `fields` (String) The form's fields, as JSON.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the ticket form.
- `name` (String) Internal name of the form.
- `title` (String) Heading shown above the form.
- `updated_at` (String) When the form was last changed (RFC 3339).
